{{Quote|Said he demanded food and credits&mdash;claimed he was on his way back from the Vesla system.''"<br />"''Vesla's a black sector&mdash;ceded to the Empire in the treaty&hellip;|[[Marcus Trant]] and [[Theron Shan]]|<ref name="TLS1">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref>}}
A '''Black sector''' was a classification given to [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] that were ceded by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as part of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] which ended the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="TLS1" />
